body:
# CreakingPerks
**Made by apoapiodev**

CreakingPerks is a Folia-compatible plugin for Paper 1.21.3+ featuring 9 modular gameplay enhancements. All modules are toggleable via `/creakinghelp` with an interactive chat GUI and fully configurable through config.yml.

## Features

**HarderCreakings**: Creakings gain Speed X, deal 10 hearts damage, apply blindness on hit, and emit darkness aura to nearby players.

**HarderBreeze**: Breeze spawns falling Wind Charges when damaging players, attacks 5x faster, and creates visual explosions with knockback.

**HarderBogged**: Bogged inflicts green bleeding that drops particles on ground. Mobs stepping on blood particles gain full health, 25% size increase, 50% damage boost, and speed/resistance for 10 seconds.

**HarderArmadillo**: Armadillos create protective spheres (10-35 block radius based on health) that block all projectiles for 5 seconds after taking damage.

**HappyGhastBomber**: Ride Ghasts and drop TNT (visual or real explosions). Creates radiation zones causing knockback, fire, item drops, and debuffs. Chainmail helmets provide protection. Commands: `/activarbombardero`, `/desactivarbombardero`.

**HarderStray**: Strays apply freeze effect for 5 seconds with two modes: max health reduction (-0.5 hearts/second) or direct damage (8 hearts/second). Includes slowness, mining fatigue, and ice particles.

**IllusionerSpawn**: Illusioners spawn naturally with 0.1% chance replacing hostile mobs. Drop Enchanted Golden Apples on death. Smart spawning in dark areas 30-60 blocks from players.

**LavaDamage**: Regular armor melts in 6 seconds in lava. Netherite armor repairs itself but cooks the player (2 hearts/second) and melts inventory items every 2 seconds.

**DryWeapon**: Craftable weapon (8 Copper Blocks + 1 Leaf Litter) with 150 durability. Uses Leaf Litter as ammo (1-10 per shot). Random fire rate (1-3 shots/second). Deals 0.5-1 heart damage up to 10 blocks. 20% chance each for: Tornado (lifts players based on hits), Burning Leaves (fire on movement), Vegetal Splinter (slowness/fatigue), Durability Damage (damages items). 5% craft fail chance.

## Commands
- `/creakinghelp [page]` - Interactive module GUI
- `/creakingmodule toggle <module>` - Toggle modules
- `/activarbombardero` - Activate bomber mode
- `/desactivarbombardero` - Deactivate bomber mode

## Technical
- API: 1.21.3
- Java: 21
- Folia-compatible with region schedulers
- All modules configurable in config.yml
- Changes persist across restarts
